title: Chapter 9: The Mother-Grove Amphitheater, The Unburied Leitmotif & The Starfield Calibration Sessions (Stardate 49603.5)
summary: Following the converging crimson-and-cyan mycelial veins inland during Ring-Night, the family discovers the natural tiered basalt Mother-Grove Amphitheater—where Cassidy's 1985 synthesizer leitmotif echoes back from 100-foot crystal fronds and the family spends the entire Vesperan night recording the 14-track Starfield Calibration album in synchronous Cosmic Tidal Lock.
